verdict.rationale: Notte's core offering is natural-language task execution. The GitHub README says to "give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites", the marketing page promises "Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors", and the docs show a plain-English prompt example plus an agent-start API. The MCP server additionally lets external AI agents drive Notte conversationally. One community user reported a failed extraction on a specific site, which is a single anecdote about reliability rather than a refutation of the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that NL tasks work reliably across sites, and deeper first-party docs on how the NL command interface handles ambiguity and failures.
